decision.t: 10. Diagnosis = PRAEVIA, ABRUPTIO, SHOCK or any §2 → resuscitate (fluids, 2 O-neg + FDP), AROM if abruptio with dead fetus, then REFER urgently
11. APH OF UNKNOWN ORIGIN or LOCAL CAUSE, stable → ADMIT — stabilise, then continue on the APH management chart and the 24-hour APH nursing record.

chart.phase_note: Praevia, abruptio or shock: stabilise and REFER — later rows apply while waiting, or to APH of unknown origin kept at ANDH. ANDH: ultrasound, CTG, 2 O-neg + FDP; no CS, theatre, induction or blood bank.

standing.t: Bleeding / shocked / awaiting transfer: BP, pulse, bleeding (pads), uterus every 15 min · FHR with each set
Bleeding settled: BP, pulse, pads hourly × 12 h, then 4-hourly
CTG 6-hourly until bleeding stops, then daily (unknown origin)
Abruptio: catheter — urine output hourly; fluid balance; watch for PET, pulmonary oedema
Act on: SBP < 80 · HR > 120 · shock index > 1.5 · urine < 30 mL/h for > 4 h · new pain, hard uterus, FHR change

rows.label: 0 h
rows.lead: NO digital vaginal examination until placenta praevia is excluded on ultrasound. Check what was given before arrival †. Stay calm and supportive.

feed.t: Left lateral; oxygen by mask; keep warm
Abruptio: aim SBP ≥ 100; beware overload with PET

FHR each set; CTG 6-hourly until bleeding stops, then daily (heavy lines)

call.t: Call the doctor for new or more bleeding · new pain, hard or tender uterus · FHR change or absent · contractions · SBP < 80 · pulse > 120 · shock index > 1.5 · urine < 30 mL/h for > 4 h · breathlessness · bleeding from gums or drip sites
